text: Progress 2026-08-03: the source-grounded review identified real semantic-loss seams and added evidence around structural design provenance, typed hypotheses/estimability, stable HRF basis identity, response-level functionals, and public S07/S10/S16 acceptance scenarios. The expanded implementation passes the complete first-level JVM+JS gate. This is not completion of the larger roadmap: Phase 1 stays open with explicit covariance-artifact, independent design-oracle, cross-solver rank-deficiency, and broader Phase 2-4 scenario gaps.
